[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.1.1
notes.notes: Welcome to the Early Access release of Salvo Subs! All feedback is welcome in the Steam Discussions area. Keep in mind there are lots of features still in the works and the game is still in the Beta phase of development.
